title: TC-ES-01-05/06 and TC-ES-03-02/03 pure input-validation tests stubbed despite requiring no DB
summary: tests/unit/event_store_test.zig unconditionally skips: TC-ES-01-05 (nil actor_id), TC-ES-01-06 (JSON array payload), TC-ES-03-02 (empty idempotency_key), TC-ES-03-03 (idempotency_key > 255 bytes). All four test cases exercise input validation guards that run before any SQL statement is executed. They are pure in-process checks: nil actor_id and array payload are rejected by EventStore.append before touching the DB; empty and oversized idempotency_key are rejected by EventStore.appendIdempotent before the DB call. These tests should be runnable as unit tests today without any PostgreSQL connection.

root_cause.details: Same classification error as ISS-0038. The EventStore input validation was incorrectly assumed to require DB access. The validation logic in append() and appendIdempotent() checks actor_id, payload type, and idempotency_key length before constructing any SQL query.

prevention: Input validation tests (nil checks, length checks, type checks) should never be stubbed as needing DB access unless the validation is performed inside a DB trigger or stored procedure.
Code review of test stubs should include a quick check: does the tested function actually reach a DB call before returning the expected error?
